name: kanmer
description: MCP-driven Kanban / ticket / plan / research manager with an Electron GUI, sharing one .kanmer file store between AI agents and humans.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kanmer/core && npm run build -w @kanmer/mcp-server
scripts.build:ui: npm run build -w @kanmer/core && npm run build -w @kanmer/ui
scripts.test: npm run check:manual && npm run test -w @kanmer/core && npm run test -w @kanmer/gui && npm run test:http -w @kanmer/mcp-server && npm run test:scripts
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && npm run build -w @kanmer/gui
scripts.app: npm run build -w @kanmer/gui && npm run start -w @kanmer/gui
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build -w @kanmer/gui && npm run dist -w @kanmer/gui
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node packages/mcp-server/dist/index.js --root ./sandbox
